purpose: Define the later human-controlled evidence entries without performing any real account, publication, payment or order action in 25-A.

entries.requiredAuthorization: One explicit authorization for this exact two-group text-only acceptance run.
entries.riskSummary: Real publication can create publicly visible content; no image upload or extra target is allowed.
prerequisites: no shared article identity across targets
recordFields: remote link only if the user authorizes recording it
stopConditions: unexpected fee or non-text side effect

entries.requiredAuthorization: Separate explicit authorization for a bounded real website-media order status refresh; this is not order creation authorization.
entries.riskSummary: A real order refresh can expose supplier state and may have cost or account consequences; no create, cancel, appeal or payment action is allowed by this entry.
prerequisites: known existing order chosen by the user
stopConditions: refresh would create or cancel an order
